settings-lookup.note: one cold lookup: finding the files includes one find fork for the world-writable check (security), plus the lookup awk

settings-lookup-10.note: ten lookups in one process: the file list is found once (cached per directory), then one awk per lookup

land-batch-checks-one-pr.note: a dry run over one PR with the stub gh: settings, a local clone and every eligibility check; about 190 ms measured

pane-ask-read.note: crew-nodes' pane-ask --read with the stub ssh and herdr: the settings lookups, one ssh call, the remote sh and herdr. Each of its herdr calls costs about the same, plus the network

changes-hook-present-fast.note: memory-notices' changes-hook around a stub claude-memsync that returns at once; owner's target: every per-prompt hook under 200 ms, this wrapper well inside it

changes-hook-timeout.note: a stub that never returns, with the wrapper's timeout set to 500 ms: wall time must stay under timeout + 300 ms (the TERM, the 200 ms grace and the KILL). Measured with 5 runs; a hard limit, not loosened in CI (ci_headroom 1.0)

crewkit-node-report.note: crewkit node report with the stub herdr, three agents and a node state. Budget is the owner's 200 ms hot-path target, not a fit to the measurement: measured p95 181.8 ms at load1 6.67 (2026-10-29), when four other scenarios also ran 1.2-2x over theirs
